Class MethodLookup

java.lang.Object
sootup.callgraph.MethodLookup
public final class MethodLookup extends Object
JVM method lookup shared by all call graph / points-to algorithms, a cached front end of MemberResolution:
  • find(MethodSignature) resolves a method reference from its referenced class, see MemberResolution.resolveMethod(View, MethodSignature). It may return an abstract method (e.g. a re-abstracted override); findConcrete(ClassType, MethodSubSignature) maps that to empty.
  • select(ClassType, SootMethod) and dispatch(ClassType, MethodSignature) pick the method a receiver class runs for a call, which is not always the first one with the same sub-signature, see MemberResolution.selectMethod(View, ClassType, SootMethod).

Not pluggable on purpose: JVM semantics, one right answer. Pluggable target models (reflection, invokedynamic) live elsewhere.

Cache: per (class, sub-signature) and per (receiver class, resolved method), misses included; dropped when the type hierarchy modification count changes. One instance per analysis, holds the view strongly.
